segments.text: In a land where magic runs through the earth like blood through veins...
The villagers call it the Dawncore.
They say it purifies the water, blesses the harvest, and keeps the darkness at bay.
They say it was once the crown jewel of the Titan-King Aldrath, whose armor no blade could pierce and whose march made mountains tremble.
They say a lot of things.
True or not — the creatures of the wild believe every word. And they want it for themselves.
Some people plant roots. Some people never stop moving.
Rover is the latter — a wandering mage who lives job to job, road to road, with no destination in mind.
She wasn't looking for trouble. Trouble, as always, found her first.
